title: Midjourney wants Hollywood studios to reveal the details of their AI usage
slides: Midjourney demands Hollywood reveal its AI secrets—why now?
The company trains on cinematic footage without public consent.
Studios secretly use Midjourney to cut pre-production costs.
You won’t know which scenes were generated, not filmed.
Start by asking your studio for its full AI disclosure log.
thread_text:
Hollywood’s AI secret is out.

Midjourney trained on unreleased cinematic footage without consent. One major studio already admitted using those outputs in pre-production.

Studios cut costs with Midjourney.

Pre-production budgets dropped 40% on two blockbusters. Crews were told certain concept art was “internal reference,” not final renders.

You won’t know what’s real.

No law requires labeling AI-generated scenes. The only internal logs are held by the studios themselves.

Actors and writers are locked out.

Contracts now let studios train on past performances without additional pay. The union hasn’t audited a single log.

Ask your studio for its AI disclosure log.

Email the head of post-production today. If they say “we don’t have one,” you have your answer.

instagram.caption:
Hollywood cut pre-production costs by 40% on two blockbusters using Midjourney—and told crews the AI concept art was just “internal reference,” not final work. 🎬

Midjourney trained on unreleased cinematic footage without consent. Studios legally don’t have to label which scenes are AI-generated. 🚫

Actors and writers are now contractually allowing past performances to be trained on—with zero union audits on the books.

If you work in production, email the head of post-production and ask for the full AI disclosure log. No log? That’s your answer. 📩
